name: Lakehouse
summary: PySpark 3.5 with Delta Lake in local mode, S3-compatible object storage (SeaweedFS) and JupyterLab for lakehouse projects.

services.name: workspace
services.purpose: Your development container: Python 3.12, Java 17, PySpark + Delta Lake, JupyterLab

reset.label: Reset object storage
reset.command: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait

limitations: Spark runs in local mode (one machine); there is no cluster, Unity Catalog or Databricks runtime.
The first Spark session downloads the Delta Lake jars from Maven Central (a few MB, needs internet).
Writing Delta tables to S3 (`s3a://`) downloads hadoop-aws and the AWS SDK bundle (about 300 MB) on first use.
Spark needs memory: close other heavy apps, and use a 4-core Codespace or larger.
